complete_input_common.common_premise: Registered consumed item, actual player-owned actor, valid current global Bag/current choice; each reached callback and scene normal unless the precise failure case is stated. No plugin or arbitrary array mutation assumed.
complete_input_common.failure_prefix: No rollback/ensure: choice/Bag/HP/scene/earlier actor mutations can survive later errors; only reached paths refund or clear.
complete_input_common.persistence: Bag and attached Pokemon mutations are persistent objects; choice runtime. Native save/reload not executed or certified by this package.

meaning: A rejected CanUse in party/battler/direct item executor calls ReturnUnusedItemToBag but does not clear choice item/action. Successful handler normalreturn clears choice item, not necessarily the action tag. Ball executor clears after its actual trigger returns.

For consumed player-owned items, ReturnUnused consults current global Bag can_add then add; otherwise raises. Earlier returned inventory and unchanged choice can coexist. Registration previously wrote choice before initial consume.
received_complete_facts.remaining: Receiver owns full Bag/storage helpers and actual item handler/data qualification; no universal refund idempotency or arbitrary callback success is inferred.

meaning: Next CommandPhase sets flag, notifies scene, then for each nonnil actor whose CanShowCommands is true calls ClearChoice directly, without ReturnUnusedItem. CanShow needs actor alive and !usingMultiTurnAttack.

MultiTurn query checks truthy TwoTurnAttack or positive HyperBeam/Rollout/Outrage/Uproar/Bide. ClearChoice sets actionNone/index0/move-or-targetnil/target−1. If qualification false, this specific phase does not perform that clear.
received_complete_facts.remaining: Other action-selection/callback writers may alter choices later; this is only actual next-phase initial clear.

meaning: Reached normal EndOfBattle calls Scene.EndBattle before its nonnil actor loop CancelChoice. CancelChoice sees UseItem and truthy item and returns unused item before unregisterMega/ClearChoice. A first failed-use refund that left these fields can therefore be returned again if unchanged and this normal path reaches it; no once-only ledger is present in these methods.

Formal Faint requires localHP<=0 and notalreadyfainted; after its earlier scene/effects/status/form steps calls ClearChoice directly, with no unused-item refund in that clear. Thus a reached faint clear can remove the residual reference before a later end CancelChoice.

Error during normalEnd before target CancelChoice, during refund or during earlier Faint callbacks can prevent laterclear; already added inventory/prior object writes remain. DebugAbort/nonordinary exit is not equated with normal EndOfBattle.
received_complete_facts.remaining: These bounded source facts add no new formal finding, mandatory fixture or global exact-history classification. Existing WP28§3.5.1 correct qualified contract remains protected.

meaning: At normal pbEndOfBattle entry oldDecision is copied; wild win with caughtPokemon changes current decision to4, while the win/loss/capture presentation branch uses oldDecision. RecordAndStoreCaught precedes capture PayDay, internal global $player.party Pokerus, scene end, per-battler CancelChoice/active OnSwitchOut(true), then current pbParty(0) per-Pokemon Peer leaving and initial-item assignment.

The battle-end Peer call receives usedInBattle[0][party index], true. This read index is not universally the same as the slot/2 index written by ordinary participation. This package preserves that distinction and does not equate merged pbParty(0) with global $player.party or give party1 a matching item-restore loop.

Peer skips nil Pokemon; calls getFormOnLeavingBattle with actual used/end arguments; a truthy differing result sets Pokemon.form; current HP is capped to totalhp if greater; then changePokemonOnLeavingBattle runs. Ruby integer0 is truthy, so returned form0 can be applied.

The complete BURMY registration returns no leaving form unless endBattle AND usedInBattle are truthy. On that qualified path battle.environment Rock/Sand/Cave yields1, None yields2, other yields0. Ordinary switch/faint Peer calls omit endBattle and therefore cannot trigger this BURMY leaving-form change merely because the used flag is true.
complete_facts.failure: Any reached callback/scene/form setter/item assignment may raise; earlier stored captures, money, Pokerus, choice cancellation, earlier forms/items remain committed. No rollback or ensure continuation is promised. Pokemon.item= is the normal-end assignment receiver, not Battler.item=.
remaining: Precise usedInBattle producer defect/correct party identity is retained from the independently scoped original root finding; this packet does not reopen or globally deduplicate it.
All other MultipleForms registrations, save/native reload and successful runtime remain OPEN outside explicitly received facts.

meaning: Arena EndOfRound first calls super and returns on any nonzero decision. Otherwise it adds each current slot successState.skill to the accumulated skill, increments count, and returns while count<3. At judgment both battlers CancelMoves(true), suppressing the final-turn Outrage confusion branch; TwoTurnAttack/Rollout/Outrage/Uproar/Bide/FuryCutter reset, and currentMove clears only if HyperBeam==0. HyperBeam is not cancelled.

Mind/skill comparison gives each side1 for ties, or the winner2 and loser0. Body is floor(currentHP*100/max(starthp,1)); its comparison uses the same ratings. Judgment UI gets cloned rating arrays. Rating sums decide tie/both or one loser. Each affected battler receives hp=0, then Faint(false); GainExp and Arena EORSwitch follow.

Battler hp= writes both local integer HP and attached persistent Pokemon.hp. Faint(false) still runs scene faint, opposing defeated marking, runtime reset/statusNONE/count0, qualified happiness change, Peer leaving with default endBattlefalse, unmega/unprimal, choice clear, side last-faint stamp, direct-damage ledger reset, faint ability callbacks and primordial weather check. The source comment about not really losing HP does not suppress the real write-through.
complete_facts.failure: If the first tie branch battler HP/faint callback raises, the later battler and GainExp/EORSwitch need not run; prior HP/status/form/callback writes survive. Judgment scene can fail before HP writes. No general successful cleanup or transaction is assumed.
remaining: Individual OnFainting/ability/final save consumers remain their separate bounded obligations.

meaning: Playback initializer takes the recorded arrays/properties and restores parties/trainers for super; Start restores party-start arrays, internal flag, weather/duration, canRun, style/anims, backdrop/base/time/environment, owner items and rules before super. Neither complete initializer nor Start restores a global player Bag snapshot.

PlaybackBattle, PalacePlaybackBattle and ArenaPlaybackBattle include RecordedBattlePlaybackModule and inherit their live Battle classes; these shown playback classes do not include RecordedBattleModule. Playback CommandPhaseLoop returns for non-player phase, increments round, loops exact four indices, skips empty recorded rows, clears each nonempty slot choice, and BAG calls pbRegisterItem with stored item/target/move.

Base RegisterItem writes UseItem plus all three item/target/move values before ConsumeItemInBag. Nil item or registered nonconsumed item returns without removal. A consumed player-owned item calls current global $bag.remove and raises if false; a nonplayer item uses current owner items and delete_at(index) if the collection exists. Thus replayed BAG input can consume or fail against current live Bag, and the choice is already written if removal fails.

ReturnUnusedItem uses current $bag.can_add?/add for player-owned consumed item, or pushes into current nonplayer owner items; failure to return to player Bag raises. CancelChoice attempts this return before unregisterMega/ClearChoice. Playback nonempty rows use ClearChoice directly, not CancelChoice, so their command-load clear itself does not promise an unused prior item refund.
complete_facts.failure: Malformed or short recorded arrays can fail after roundindex/earlier choices advance. Missing current player item can raise after choice writes; a nonplayer missing index can error. This packet proves the explicit calls and committed prefix, not successful native playback or every Bag internal mutation failure case.
remaining: Whole serialized-record validation, native Marshal compatibility, full player inventory save/reload, and every item effect/AI suitability policy remain outside this finite contribution.
